CustomField.description: Date the source opportunity was created. Stored (not a formula) so the MEDDIC related list on the Account can be sorted by it. Set by the MEDDIC sync flows when a mirror is created or updated, and by the Sep 2026 backfill. Added 2026-09-24 per Aaron.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the deal this record belongs to was created. Sort the account's MEDDIC list by this to read the history in order.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Created Date
